name: Zero-Width Character Detector
summary: Find and strip invisible zero-width characters (ZWSP, ZWJ, BOM, soft hyphen, and more).
description: Paste text to detect zero-width and other invisible Unicode characters. See highlighted markers, a match list with code points, and a cleaned copy with invisibles removed. Everything runs locally.

faqs.question: Which characters are detected?
faqs.answer: Common invisibles including U+200B ZWSP, ZWNJ, ZWJ, LRM/RLM, word joiner, BOM (U+FEFF), soft hyphen, and several invisible math operators.

faqs.question: What does Strip do?
faqs.answer: It removes detected characters from the input so you can copy or keep editing a clean string.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Scanning runs entirely in your browser.
